blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) has issued a show cause order against the operator of an InDrive partner involved in a viral video showing a heated dispute with passengers over an additional tollway charge. LTFRB Acting Chairperson Greg Pua said the operator was directed to explain in writing why its authority to operate a transport network company (TNC) should not be suspended or canceled. The hearing is scheduled for Dec. 9. The case stemmed from a viral video showing a transport network vehicle service (TNVS) driver charging passengers an additional P39 for using an expressway […]...
